review.summary: This PR moves `prepare_linked_requirements_more` out of the resolver into individual commands (install, download, wheel) and caches the metadata-only distribution on InstallRequirement so dry-run/lock can skip downloading. The general direction is sound, but the dry-run code path in install.py still calls `prepare_linked_requirements_more`, which appears to defeat the stated purpose — full downloads will still occur before the dry-run early-return check. Additionally, `req.prepared`/`needs_more_preparation` flag-setting was deleted from the resolver but not clearly relocated, raising regression risk for downstream code that depends on those flags. The `set_dist`/`get_dist` cache also changes semantics in ways that may shadow a real built distribution post-install.

issues.description: install.py unconditionally calls prepare_linked_requirements_more before the dry-run check, defeating the PR's stated purpose
issues.detail: The added `preparer.prepare_linked_requirements_more(...)` in install.py runs before the `--dry-run` early-return logic later in `run()`. The news entry and PR description claim dry-run no longer downloads, but this call still triggers full wheel downloads for non-PEP-658 cases and may still download for dry-run. The call must be gated on `not options.dry_run` or moved below the dry-run return.

issues.description: Removed `req.prepared = True` / `needs_more_preparation = False` flag updates from resolver are not replaced
issues.detail: The resolver previously set `req.prepared = True` and `req.needs_more_preparation = False` after calling `prepare_linked_requirements_more`. The new code in commands calls the prepare method but does not reset these flags. Downstream code that branches on `req.prepared` or `needs_more_preparation` (e.g. installer logic) may now see stale flags, causing re-preparation or assertion failures.

issues.description: `get_dist()` prefers cached `_distribution` over `metadata_directory`, potentially returning stale metadata-only dist after full prep
issues.detail: After PEP-658 metadata fetch caches `_distribution`, a later `prepare_linked_requirements_more` populates `metadata_directory` with the actual built/extracted dist. `get_dist()` now returns the cached metadata-only dist first, ignoring the more authoritative directory distribution. This can cause install to use header metadata instead of the wheel's real METADATA, producing subtle divergence (e.g., dynamic fields, RECORD).

issues.description: Setting `download_info` from `direct_url_from_link(req.link, req.source_dir)` lacks hash/archive info available only after download
issues.detail: `direct_url_from_link` with no downloaded archive produces a DirectUrl without `ArchiveInfo.hash`/`hashes`. `pip install --report` and `pip lock` rely on download_info hashes for reproducibility. Populating download_info here with empty hashes silently degrades the JSON report's integrity guarantees compared to the prior behavior where download_info was set after real download.

issues.description: `pip lock` code path is not updated in this diff despite news entry claiming it benefits
issues.detail: The news file states `pip lock` no longer downloads full distributions, but no change to a lock command is visible in the diff. If `pip lock` calls `prepare_linked_requirements_more` similarly to install, it will still download; if it doesn't, the resolver-removal change may break a flow that depended on the old in-resolver preparation. Either way the claim needs verification or an explicit code change.

issues.description: `set_dist` has no docstring and bypasses internal invariants used by `metadata` property
issues.detail: `set_dist` is a public-looking setter that mutates `_distribution` with no validation, no docstring, and no interaction with `_metadata` caching used by the `metadata` property. Future callers may set inconsistent state. A brief docstring describing the PEP-658 caching intent and contract (one-shot, metadata-only) would prevent misuse.
